name: Kono Yoru ga Akenai you ni Kiss Shite
original_name: この夜が明けないようにキスをして
source:
Caressing fingers.
Burning looks.
A voice full of desire.
A face at rest.
Sleeping in his arms.
What could be sweeter?
This relationship doesn’t need labels.
The story of a love in vain…
Until it isn’t.
